about: Reviewed pins of the iPhone18,2 iOS 27.0.1 (24A446) kernelcache.release.v54 for OneiOS's kernel.kc: addresses and names, no Apple code. Addresses are original kernelcache VAs. Each record names bytes of the original (address, size, SHA-256) that emit.py checks before it uses the record.

early_security_init.evidence: AMFI's kmod start (0xfffffe000923e448, libkmod's _start) reads a NULL _realmain (0xfffffe000b9023c8) and returns 0, so starting the kext registers nothing. AMFI's only call of mac_policy_register (through its stub 0xfffffe000924f448, GOT slot 0xfffffe000812d890) is in 0xfffffe0009232214 (_initializeAppleMobileFileIntegrity). That function has two callers in AMFI: 0xfffffe000923211c (62 instructions) and this one, eight instructions: bti c; pacibsp; stp x29, x30; mov x29, sp; bl 0xfffffe0009232214; mov w0, #0; ldp; retab. It is the void-to-int wrapper native-security-init.patch calls from OSKext::start (_NativePrelinkEarlySecurityInit). The iPad profile's pin (0xfffffe00092551ac of kernelcache.release.j820) is the same wrapper by its description.

sites.evidence: AppleMobileFileIntegrity's GOT slot for PAGE_SHIFT_CONST (target 0xfffffe0007df0ac8). Its only reader in AMFI is 0xfffffe000923fcc0: adrp/ldr the slot, ldr w8, [x8]; mvn(-1 << w8) & sp; cmp #128: the CoreEntitlements DER iterator's stack check of XnuPrelink's 24A446 (iPad) and 26C5035r fixtures. The hosted kernel is the same 4 KiB BCM2837 configuration with the same stack allocation, so the slot is bound to unixnu_kernel_stack_shift (the allocation alignment shift) as there.
